Alt spreads (home_big + away_big) are the #1 profitable category across ALL traders
team_total_home_under has 59-64% win rate across all traders — hidden gem
team_total_home_over has 74-81% win rate but low volume — needs more action
h1_ml_away has near 100% win rate (tiny sample) — worth exploring as specialist
ml_home is a trap: looks safe but negative profit for 4 of 5 traders
spread_home and spread_away are break-even at best — avoid as primary
Sharpe ratio matters more than raw ROI: Claude (4.423) outperformed Gemini (2.660) risk-adjusted
Conference matchups have higher edge than division games
